info.name: Gym Management API
info.description: Backend API for the Gym Management System: the member app (/api/v1) and the admin portal (/api/admin).

item.name: Member App — Auth
item.description:
Member registration and login. A new member stays pending until an admin
approves them; only approved, active members can log in.

request.description:
Submit a membership registration. No token is returned: the member can
log in once an admin approves the registration.

Returns a Bearer token for an approved, active member. Pending, rejected
and inactive members get 403 with error_code MEMBER_PENDING,
MEMBER_REJECTED (plus errors.rejection_reason) or MEMBER_INACTIVE.
Revokes the token used for this request.

The member, gym name and timezone, today's opening hours, whether the gym is open now,
the next 3 events, the latest 3 news items, and counts for this month's events and policies.

Seven days, Monday first, with today's day (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday), whether the gym
is open now, and the timezone the times are in.

query.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the current month.

request.description: Published events that overlap the month (gym time), earliest first. Not paginated.
404 if the event doesn't exist or isn't published.

item.name: Member App — News & Policies
item.description: "current" lists published items; "archive" lists older, archived items. Drafts are never shown.

request.description: Paginated, 10 per page, newest first. List items have no body.

item.name: Show a news item or policy

request.description: Includes the body. 404 for drafts.
The logged-in member's details, including membership number and status.

item.name: Admin Portal — Auth
item.description: Admin login for the portal. Only users with the admin role can log in here.

request.description: Returns a Bearer token plus the admin's roles and permissions.
Revokes the token used for this request.
Includes the admin's roles and permissions.

Member counts, registrations for the last six months, the oldest pending and newest members,
event and content counts with the next events and latest content, and the gym's open status.
Cached for up to 60 seconds; changes made through the API refresh it immediately.

item.name: Admin Portal — Members
item.description:
Manage gym members and their registrations. Approve or reject pending
registrations, activate or deactivate approved members. Invalid transitions
return 409 with error_code INVALID_MEMBER_TRANSITION.

query.description: Name, email, phone or membership number.
Sort column: id, name, email, status, created_at, approved_at.

request.description: Profile fields only; use the approval actions to change status.
Soft-deletes the member and revokes their tokens.
Allowed for pending or rejected members. Activates the member and assigns a membership number.
Allowed for pending members only. The reason is shown to the member when they try to log in.
Allowed for approved, inactive members.
Allowed for approved, active members. Revokes their tokens, signing them out of the app.

item.name: Admin Portal — Gym Timings
item.description: Weekly opening hours. Times are "HH:mm" in the gym's timezone.

request.description: All seven days, Monday first, with the gym timezone and whether it is open now.
Send all seven days. A closed day stores no times; an open day needs closes_at after opens_at.

item.name: Admin Portal — Event Types
item.description:
Kinds of gym events (Class, Workshop, Competition…) with a badge colour.
A type that is used by events can't be deleted (409 EVENT_TYPE_IN_USE); deactivate it instead.

request.description: Active types for dropdowns: [{ value, title, color }], ordered by name.

body.raw: {"name":"b","color":"#fEEeDb","description":"Accusantium harum mollitia modi deserunt aut ab.","is_active":true}
{"name":"b","color":"#fEEeDb","description":"Accusantium harum mollitia modi deserunt aut ab.","is_active":true}

item.name: Admin Portal — Events
item.description:
Gym events with an optional image. Send dates as local gym time ("2026-10-05 18:00")
or ISO-8601 with an offset. Create and update with an image as multipart; for updates,
use POST with _method=PUT.

query.description: Sort column: id, title, starts_at, created_at.

formdata.description: Must match an existing stored value.
Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Must not be greater than 5000 characters.
Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Must be a valid date.
Must be a valid date. Must be a date after or equal to starts_at.
Must be at least 1.
Must match an existing stored value.
Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Must not be greater than 5000 characters.
Must not be greater than 150 characters.
Must be a valid date.
Must be a valid date.
Must be at least 1.

request.description: Partial update. Send remove_image=1 to delete the current image.
Also deletes its image.

item.name: Admin Portal — News & Policies
item.description:
News items and policies share these endpoints ("type" = news or policy).
Lifecycle: draft → published → archived; archived items can be re-published.
Invalid transitions return 409 with error_code INVALID_CONTENT_TRANSITION.
Send create and update with an image as multipart; for updates, use POST with _method=PUT.

query.description: Sort column: id, title, published_at, created_at.

item.name: Create a news item or policy

formdata.description: Must not be greater than 200 characters.
Must not be greater than 500 characters.
Must not be greater than 65000 characters.

request.description: Saved as draft unless status=published.

item.name: Show a news item or policy
Update a news item or policy

formdata.description: Must not be greater than 200 characters.
Must not be greater than 500 characters.
Must not be greater than 65000 characters.

request.description: Text and image only; type and status can't be changed here. Send remove_image=1 to delete the image.

item.name: Delete a news item or policy

request.description: Also deletes its image.
Draft or archived → published.
Published → archived. Members see archived items under "older".
